F1: RPCs no longer check shutdown state and can access the backend after Stop cancels only the server context.
F2: Builds for the same key can overlap, colliding on disk or replacing a cached index that another caller is using.
F3: The new startup TotalDocs call iterates the cache without locking after starting a goroutine that can modify it.
F4: The shared error and counter races are in unchanged worker code and predate this change.
